scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/admin && npm run build -w apps/print-bridge
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/print-bridge
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npx -w apps/web tsc --noEmit && npx -w apps/admin tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w apps/print-bridge
